meta.name: add-resend
meta.description: Add Resend (email) channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 集成 Resend 邮件发送通道到聊天应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在聊天应用中添加邮件发送能力
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Resend email channel into your chat app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add email sending to a chat application

howto.what: 让 NanoClaw 通过 Resend 收发邮件。它会把 Resend 适配器复制进项目、注册通道并安装依赖，再引导你配置 Resend 账户、域名、API 密钥和 webhook，最后把你的邮箱设为管理员并发一封 hello 测试邮件。
howto.when: 当你想给 NanoClaw 加上 Resend 邮件通道、让它能收发邮件时使用；也适用于 /setup 流程中需要邮件集成时。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 添加 Resend 邮件通道
say.note: 开始执行技能，复制适配器并注册。

say.text: 配置 Resend 的 API 密钥和 webhook
say.note: 会提示你粘贴密钥，并写入 .env。

say.text: 把我的邮箱设为管理员并发一封测试邮件
say.note: 设置 owner 后，你会收到 hello 邮件。

howto.what_en: Adds Resend email support to NanoClaw. It copies the Resend adapter, registers the channel, installs the pinned dependency, guides you through Resend account/domain/API key/webhook setup, then sets your email as owner and sends a hello test email.
howto.when_en: Use when you want NanoClaw to send and receive email via Resend, or during a /setup flow that needs email integration.

say_en.text: Add the Resend email channel to NanoClaw
say_en.note: Starts the skill: copies adapter and registers.

say_en.text: Set up the Resend API key and webhook
say_en.note: Prompts for secrets and writes them to .env.

say_en.text: Set my email as owner and send a test email
say_en.note: Wires you as owner; you'll get a hello email.
